perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Fiscal Q1 2027 net sales were $1.485B, up 38% year over year and 13.2% sequentially; inventory days declined to 175 from 185 and non-GAAP gross margin rose to 63.8%.
Management reported book-to-bill well above 1 and PCIe Gen6 design wins doubling sequentially to 12 programs, a potentially useful data-center/connectivity signal.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Recovery evidence is visible in sales, utilization, inventory normalization and margins, but one quarter does not prove a full semiconductor-cycle recovery; design wins require conversion into production revenue.

contradictions: Strong current growth follows a depressed prior-year base, so year-over-year acceleration may overstate normalized demand strength.
unknowns: production revenue timing from PCIe Gen6 wins

lineage.searchStrategy: issuer primary plus filing-backed corroboration; recovery claims bounded to observed quarter
